name: Passbolt
description: Password manager for teams, with end to end encryption and MariaDB.
note: Make the first admin in the passbolt service terminal: su -m -c "/usr/share/php/passbolt/bin/cake passbolt register_user -u you@example.com -f First -l Last -r admin" -s /bin/sh www-data. Open the link it prints. Fill in SMTP so invites can be sent.
